paragraphs.body: The Charlotte Hornets suffered a decisive 128-81 loss to the Atlanta Hawks in their first home game without LaMelo Ball, resulting in a blowout that left the team looking lost despite a sellout crowd booing the performance. AP News reported the team struggled significantly, with Coby White sending a blunt message after a 27-turnover collapse that highlighted the team's difficulties. Yahoo Sports noted that fans are asking questions after Naz Reid was shockingly benched, while the team desperately needs Kon Knueppel and Coby White back from injury to improve. The State Hornet described the game as a strong start where new faces turned heads in a 40-point victory, though the outcome suggests the team is still adjusting.

Beyond the recent game results, the Charlotte Hornets are preparing to retire the jersey of former star Muggsy Bogues, an event that will be covered in an emotional press conference. FOX Carolina News reported on Bogues' upcoming appearance, while Yahoo Sports highlighted the team's surprise plan to honor the veteran. DAZN suggested that the Hornets are showing early signs of excitement among fans following the LaMelo Ball trade, though the team remains focused on rebuilding and addressing roster needs.

headline: Charlotte Hornets face tough road ahead after blowout loss, focusing on Bogues jersey retirement and rebuilding roster.
